contract.semanticRoles: Use native semantic elements and meaningful roles for interactive and document structures.
contract.keyboardAndFocus: All controls are keyboard reachable, focus-visible, ordered meaningfully, and free of traps.
contract.accessibleLabels: Interactive controls have meaningful accessible names; decorative and duplicate labels are omitted.
contract.ariaBindings: ARIA binds semantics where needed and never substitutes for correct native structure.
contract.contrastAndReadability: Validate readability using PiMath color and typography authorities; do not define a palette.
contract.nonColorOnlyMeaning: State and meaning use text, semantic icons, geometry styles, or other non-color signals.
contract.reducedMotion: Suppress unnecessary decorative motion while preserving mathematical and pedagogical meaning.
contract.mathAccessibility: Derive accessible math from canonical notation without changing mathematical meaning.
contract.figureGraphAccessibility: Derive descriptions from semantic geometry and visual provenance; do not infer absent relations.
contract.documentAccessibility: Preserve reading order, headings, grouping, tables, labels, and answer structure.
contract.videoAccessibility: Maintain provenance linking caption, transcript, and narration without changing video visual semantics.
